list: Competition kit list frozen 2026-11-18; not independently verified in-game

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 single-player trophies. Keep chapter-boundary saves and protect the Chapter 1 Jason-house meditation, whose necessity remains unconfirmed. After the story, use Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to finish the larger targets, including 300 stunts, 70 challenges and 15 card sets, then complete remaining stranger strands and miscellaneous trophies. PowerPyx estimates about 200 hours and 4/10 difficulty overall.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission in Chapter 1, for an automatic story unlock. Keep a Chapter 1 start save if you want a return point. PowerPyx reports 15 manual save slots and recommends retaining chapter starts and ends because completed missions have no replay option.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Before leaving Chapter 1, retain a manual save and check Lucia’s morning meditation invitation at Jason’s house for the separate potentially missable trophy. Continue into Chapter 2 and complete its first main mission, What’s in the Bag?. PowerPyx identifies that completion as the automatic trigger for Paradise Lost.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Retain your Chapter 2 end save, then finish Welcome to Vice City, the first main mission of Chapter 3. PowerPyx places the automatic Chapter 2 milestone there. Its roadmap recommends keeping both chapter starts and ends, using ten of the 15 manual slots for those return points because mission replay is unavailable.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Keep a Chapter 3 end save before moving on, then complete both Ocean Beach and Another Life, the opening pair of Chapter 4 main missions. PowerPyx says this pair triggers the automatic Chapter 3 trophy. Retain chapter-boundary saves because the roadmap reports no mission replay.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 through the main story and retain saves at the chapter’s start and end. The official description establishes the chapter requirement. PowerPyx calls the unlock automatic and names Starting From Zero, but assigns that mission to the finale as well while separately describing Chapter 5. The exact mission placement remains unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final main mission, the requirement established by the official list. Keep chapter-boundary saves as the story advances because PowerPyx reports no mission replay. Its trophy paragraph calls Starting From Zero the finale in Chapter 4, while its Snow Storm entry describes Chapter 5. The ending’s exact chapter placement remains unconfirmed, and PowerPyx labels the trophy automatic.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Follow the Chapter 2 main missions through Breakfast Run and complete it for the automatic Trust trophy. Retain the Chapter 2 start save if you want to revisit this section. PowerPyx recommends start/end saves for each chapter within the 15 manual slots because the game has no mission replay.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 for this automatic main-story trophy. Keep the Chapter 3 boundary saves if you want return points for the heist section. PowerPyx recommends ten chapter-start/end saves across the story and five rotating cleanup slots, since completed missions cannot be replayed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Retain a Chapter 4 start save, then follow the main story through Child’s Play and finish it. PowerPyx identifies that mission as Family Matters’ automatic, unmissable trigger. Its chapter-save advice preserves return points within the 15 manual slots because the game has no mission replay.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in the Chapter 4 main story to receive DWNFALL automatically. Keep the Chapter 4 start/end saves recommended by PowerPyx if you want a route back to this story section. The roadmap reports 15 manual slots and no mission replay, with five slots left for rotating cleanup saves after reserving chapter boundaries.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown during the Chapter 4 main story. PowerPyx explicitly marks Hi-Jacked as an automatic, unmissable mission trophy. Preserve the Chapter 4 boundary saves recommended in its roadmap, since the 15-slot manual-save system supplies return points and completed missions have no replay option.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Follow the main story to Operation Savage Glory and complete it for Snow Storm’s automatic unlock. PowerPyx places this mission in Chapter 5, though its separate finale entries make the overall chronology unconfirmed. Retain chapter-boundary manual saves, following its advice for a game without mission replay.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the finale to inspect progress earned throughout the story. Finish 100 optional tasks, 39 operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday-loan jobs, 34 Smash ’N’ Grabs, 50 stick-ups and the fencing totals. Exploration includes 15 card sets, 15 meditations, 33 underwater discoveries and 100 WAiNK scans. Activities include 300 stunts, 70 challenges, 30 race wins, 42 range golds, 42 drone trials and Bret’s 15 target decks. Discovery needs 200 base-model vehicles, 50 weapons and 100 studied animals. The structured checklist guide details the remaining targets, and all required content remains accessible after the story.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of 397 distinct stunts using jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. PowerPyx recommends under-bridge flights for fast progress. Find named sites under Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots and inspect regional counts under Progress > Activities > Stunts. Performing each stunt once earns completion credit, with its extra map-icon challenges optional. Continue to 300 for the 100% checklist.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Record each of the nine activity types. Try fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, a scored basketball hoop and a video game, then win a car race/race challenge/drone race and perform a stunt. Use Touchpad > Progress > Activities and highlight entries to see their counts. Map > Activities, shown by the blue dumbbell, helps find remaining types as story progress and map exploration reveal them.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Buy a $5 Waiver Pass from the shooting-range clerk to reveal the local challenge markers. The checklist names Griffin Shooting Range and Rodgers Ranch. Beat each challenge’s time or score requirement for gold and review Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges. Its stated target is 42 golds, but its range count and per-venue medal arithmetic conflict internally, leaving that distribution unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Blue markers appear within about 100 meters/yards, and Map > Activities > Top Fun Drones filters them. Each site has three trials. For the 42-trial checklist target, beat par in the first two to unlock the third, which needs only a finish. Hold the left stick forward for maximum speed, avoid collisions and check Progress > Activities > Top Fun Drones for remaining trials.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 unique events from the 40 available races. Find blue race icons by approaching within about 100 meters/yards and use Map > Activities > Racing to filter them. Highlight Race Groups under Progress > Activities > Racing to inspect wins and choose unfinished events. Continue to 30 unique wins for the checklist, which also tracks race-challenge gold medals separately.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Finish Feng Shui (Meet Cal) during Chapter 1, then wait for Cal’s invitation text. It marks a fishing location in purple. Travel there, follow his fishing questline and beat him in a challenge. PowerPyx provides the mission and message trigger, while the exact delay, bait choice, named fishing spot and catch quota remain unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind using your home TV controllers, or complete Bang For Your Buck at an arcade machine. Reaching one game’s ending fulfills this trophy, with extra challenges optional. Home games are available in Chapter 1, temporarily inaccessible in Chapter 2 and available again from Chapter 3 and after the story. Progress > Activities > Games tracks games played, while the checklist separately asks you to start all four.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 to receive Andy’s call and her home address in Belville. Complete Climbing the Cellerichain Parts 1–3, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! at the initiation, Read the Label to retrieve the van, then Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse. The full questline remains available after the story. PowerPyx excludes Andy’s line from the separate eight-stranger-strands trophy.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 1’s Island Dreams, answer Kenton’s call and visit the green KR marker in Key Lento. Dive at his purple treasure-chest markers, use the metal detector on buried seabed treasure and return each set to open further wrecks, clearing seven in total. Kenton returns during Chapters 2–3 after his temporary absence, and calling Brian as Jason later in Chapter 2 can prompt his text sooner. Track Characters > Kenton Rees and Collections > Kenton’s Treasures in Progress, plus the 33 Underwater Discoveries for the checklist.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2’s Coffee Break, visit Billy’s automatically marked strand at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and finally Hometown Heroes. PowerPyx confirms the whole line remains available after the story and excludes Billy from the separate eight-stranger-strands trophy.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands and check the trophy-list tracker after completions. PowerPyx confirms Kirk’s Skunk Ape/tree-effigy/Mr. Mangrove sequence, Kyle’s farm/chemicals/Buddy? sequence, Yago’s four racing missions and Pilot Pete’s plane-and-deliveries line. Its launch guide identifies only these four qualifying strands, leaving the other four identities and their starting locations unconfirmed. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are explicitly excluded, and strangers remain available after the story.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3’s Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS to obtain the Key Cloner and deliver Randy’s first requested car, the Zorrusso. Finish his 16-car list using Map > Robberies > Randy’s Wish List. Scan sports cars with WAiNK for the delivery popup, search hotels and roads at Vice Beach/Ocean Beach, and return targets to the green RK garage in western Vice City. Clearing marked targets reveals more. Perfect-condition deliveries pay more and help the checklist’s $200,000 fenced-vehicle target.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, play as Jason and destroy the purple-marked Synthetic Labs in Vice City during Take Out Kitty Litter. Sufficient lab progress opens Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), whose completion awards the trophy. The exact required lab count is unconfirmed in the source. Each lab also contributes to the checklist’s 100 optional tasks, and Tyrone’s Jason-exclusive line remains available after the story.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Keep a Chapter 1 save and, after Down to Earth, check Lucia’s morning kitchen invitation at Jason’s house. Follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation before leaving Chapter 1. Its trophy necessity remains unconfirmed. After Coffee Break, bring both characters to shared spots and track Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The ten locations include the sandbar west of Capri, Buckskin Swamp’s lookout dock, Camp Moonflower, Manifest Canyon, the waterwheel south of Moreau, the mine-overlook tower, the waterfall northwest of Tallaloko and the outcrop east of Waning Sands. Finish the others to reveal Ascent Mountain’s peak stone circle. The checklist needs only 15 of 18 sessions.
trophies.missableStatus: Potentially missable

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Play as Jason after Chapter 2’s Coffee Break to receive Bret’s text and start Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. That mission supplies the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle and purple hunting targets. Return requested animals to Bret, using clean head or heart shots to preserve condition and improve payment. Track Map > Activities > Target Deck and Progress > Contacts > Bret Vogel. All 15 decks are needed for the checklist and remain available after the story, while the exact trophy-triggering animal is unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish three card sets from the 18 available. Inspect indoor surfaces/walls and outdoor yellow phone boxes/toolboxes. Backyard Wrestling has 12 cards and Delights Dancers has 18, offering smaller set targets. Use Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards to identify missing entries. Color variants count separately, duplicates add no new progress and pawn-shop sales preserve collection credit. Continue to 15 complete sets for A Long Road.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Explore on foot and watch for the nearby-scannable-location popup, then open WAiNK and scan the environmental object. The trophy guide lists landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags, with more than 100 scan opportunities overall. Check Progress > Collections > Waink Locations until 100 locations are credited. That same target contributes to the completion checklist.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges across eight ten-challenge categories, available from the start. In Progress > Challenges, highlight a challenge and look for the lower-right Completed checkmark. Finish other activities first to build natural progress, then select the quickest remaining tasks. A Long Road needs 70 completions, allowing you to leave ten of the 80 unfinished.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2’s Coffee Break, call your partner and reach four wanted stars together. Chapter 4 large-vault robberies provide that wanted level automatically. Use a fast motorcycle to cut through traffic and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County to break police and helicopter sightlines. Continue beyond the remaining red heat radius after the flashing search area clears, since PowerPyx says the trophy waits for that final escape.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, call your partner and prepare body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. Rob three shops while keeping the flashing red/blue wanted state active between stops. PowerPyx suggests northern Vice City’s three jewelry stores after Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs, taking several items and clearing backroom safes. Allow roughly half a minute after the third store for the delayed unlock. If police arrived after you left the first store, continue to a fourth while maintaining pursuit.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Once WAiNK unlocks in Chapter 1, scan unfamiliar vehicles until 100 discoveries register. Vary your search across Ocean Beach hotels for supercars, Port Gellhorn for vans/trucks and Key Lento for basic models, and include boats and aircraft. Review Progress > Vehicles for progress. The checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles and excludes standout vehicles from that larger total.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Check Focus under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > your character, shown by the purple eye. Build its four levels with ranges, golf, pool or fishing, then restore the bar with food/drinks or home washing and use Adrenaline to extend the window. Wear armor, bring an accurate automatic rifle such as the Duke 556 and line up criminals at a gang operation. Activate Focus while aiming and defeat five during that one activation. PowerPyx accepts kills or incapacitations and reports police, soldiers and civilians as unreliable targets.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, find the passenger plane docked to the E3/E4 boarding bridge. Drive through an airfield fence and use the stairs/door beside the bridge, or enter through the airport terminal. Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse onto the airstrip and take off. Continue flying about 1 kilometer (0.6 miles) away to trigger the delayed trophy. PowerPyx specifies a terminal-connected passenger plane for this method.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station on the island at Mariana County’s southwestern map edge. Enter through the gate or take the stunt jump beside the southeastern entrance, then head to the southern part of the air base where the tanks stand. Steal one and shoot enemies until the trophy registers. PowerPyx supplies these entry routes and the tank area, while an exact kill quota is unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3’s Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs to unlock jewelry robberies and the permanently carried Snap Gun. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. Use the Snap Gun at the locked back door, search the backroom for the safe-code note and loot the safe with that code. Disable the alarm and destroy the security footage through the backroom interactions. Leave undetected and allow a short delay for the trophy.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Finish That’s Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) in Chapter 4 for the first vault job. After Yasmani’s two payday-loan jobs, buy $10,000 van tips and tail marked security vans until guards open bank vaults. Enter, take the cash and hand a bag to your partner when full. Escape the four-star pursuit using a motorcycle and a vehicle change, repeating across five vaults. Track bank objectives under Map > Robberies > Bank Jobs. A Long Road needs all eight large jobs, including each vault, drawer and safe.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Use Chapter 4’s That’s Where The Money Is… to follow an armored van to a bank, take the deposited money from the opened vault and escape the red heat zone or use Pay ’n’ Spray. PowerPyx says that job satisfies the truck trophy. For an earlier attempt after Yasmani’s Chapter 3 unlock, find trucks near Vice City banks, block one and blast its rear door with a sticky bomb. His completed jobs supply sticky bombs behind the shop. The earlier method also requires escaping the remaining heat radius.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Inspect the map for black fog, then fly a plane over obscured areas until the entire map is visible. Recheck the remaining dark patches and cover them as part of exploration or post-story travel. PowerPyx recommends aircraft for this task, while a specific plane model, altitude and fixed flight route remain unconfirmed in the supplied paragraph.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one operation for each of the nine gang categories and collect all key valuables. Use yellow markers and Map > Robberies > Illegal Operations. The specialist page supplies examples for every group, including Fishing Shacks, Kingpin Bowling, M7 Compound, Palmer Fishing Warehouse, Farm Fix Meth Lab, Sound4Sond Studio, Southside Trap House, Saber Shipping Yard and Mill Station Radar Base. Inspect Progress > Gangs for each group’s robbed count. Missing valuables can be recovered after respawn. A Long Road needs all 39 operations, with a numbering gap in the source’s full location list still unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and order an Apple Martini. Stand beside the bar and drink it to unlock the trophy, following PowerPyx’s specific venue, cocktail and drinking-position instructions. The source gives no chapter restriction or required time of day, so those details remain unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Obtain the Key Cloner during Randy’s Chapter 3 Zorrusso mission, Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS. Find the specific blue Banshee inside the showroom in southern Vice City, hack into it and drive forward through the window. Continue along the street to allow the delayed unlock. PowerPyx identifies this car and general region, while the supplied text gives no verified street address.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Buy sticky bombs and visit Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, introduced by Chapter 2’s Hit Kingpin Bowling optional mission. Take the luxury watch from the southeastern office and the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun from the northeastern corner’s table. Blow open and loot the safe in the office off the northeastern hallway, then escape police. Missing valuables can be collected after the operation respawns, and PowerPyx says the three pickups accumulate across visits.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2’s Coffee Break, inspect each character’s heart-icon Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia. Find fitness clubs through Map > Activities, buy a membership and call your partner to train together. The partner exercises automatically while you control the other character, advancing both. Repeat until both show maximum Strength simultaneously. PowerPyx also offers home workouts after the story.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Enable Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile and watch for the demon-face notification when actions affect your profile. Build the 500-action total through robberies, evidence destruction, clean escapes, incapacitations and combat while working on other trophies. Select the trophy in the trophy list to inspect its counter. PowerPyx supplies repeated vehicle attacks as a late cleanup method and reports that Psycho increases police hostility while Irredeemable becomes permanent after sustained extreme violence.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: PowerPyx leaves the unlock method unknown and mentions a possible prologue payday-loan connection only as an unresolved theory. The trigger, required actions and availability window remain unconfirmed. If investigating, retain chapter-boundary manual saves using the roadmap’s 15-slot save system, since the source reports no mission replay. A verified walkthrough cannot be derived from the supplied launch entry.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Visit the road northwest of Starlet Motel in Kelly County alone after 2 a.m. Look for a blinking roadside car, driving away and returning if its random spawn is absent. Follow the nearby woodland path toward the bright blue sky light and approach the UFO until it drops the abducted woman. Speak to her, offer help and return to the roadside car at her request to complete the encounter.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride a motorcycle or push bike to a crowded pedestrian area in Vice City or Ocean Beach, then kick ten pedestrians within 60 seconds. PowerPyx’s launch paragraph explicitly supplies the accepted bike types, count, time window and recommended areas. Its captured text omits the controller-button mapping, so that input detail remains unconfirmed.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3’s Credit Check for the Dye Pack Jammer, then take marked bills from bank and payday-loan robberies to a fence. Accumulate $250,000 across deliveries, with PowerPyx identifying Yasmani in Vice City as the highest-paying contact. Chapter 4’s That’s Where The Money Is… unlocks large vaults paying up to $205,000 per job. Escape their four-star pursuit, fence the bills and use the post-story checklist’s marked-bills target to review the same cumulative goal.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Build a cumulative $100,000 in shop spending through purchases throughout the playthrough. PowerPyx recommends weapons, car modifications and tattoos as expensive options for finishing the total quickly. Continue buying across those shop types until the threshold is reached. A dedicated spending-menu path remains unconfirmed because the supplied paragraph gives no tracker navigation.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Complete Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) in Chapter 2 and watch for the notification installing Vice City Real Estate. Open that phone app and buy all eight purchasable garages for a combined $160,000. PowerPyx counts the four story garages separately from the purchase requirement. If funding is short, its guide recommends robberies as higher-value jobs unlock in Chapters 3–4.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, the requirement stated by Exophase and repeated by Gamersky’s Chinese trophy list. The supplied PowerPyx walkthrough omits this trophy, and neither official-list capture supplies an app unlock mission, accepted-vehicle restrictions, garage location or registration-menu sequence. Those details and the availability window remain unconfirmed, so a concrete registration route cannot yet be sourced.
trophies.missableStatus: PowerPyx reports no other missable trophies
